observation.visible_scene: A hydraulic press is shown in close-up: a yellow-and-black striped upper block connects to a polished cylindrical metal plate that sits above a black mug bearing a yellow oval Batman logo and a wire handle on the right. The mug rests on a flat metal base, its lower rim already crumpled and folded outward, with a thin haze/mist around the contact area. The background is a soft, out-of-focus greenish blur.
visible_changes: The metal press plate moves steadily downward throughout the segment, the vertical gap between the plate's lower edge and the mug's rim closing progressively.

The mug body visibly compresses/buckles as the plate descends; the yellow logo becomes increasingly obscured, shrinking from a clear oval in the early frames to a thin sliver hidden behind the crumpled edge by the last frames.
The already-deformed crumpled skirt at the mug's base stays in contact with the platform, shifting slightly outward as the body flattens.
The handle on the right remains attached but appears to tilt/flatten a little toward the base as compression continues.
The faint mist around the base persists across the segment without a clear onset or cessation within the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: How and when the crushing began (the mug is already partially collapsed at the first frame).
The final state of the mug or whether the press retracts after the last frame.
The identity of the press operator and the exact materials of the mug and press.
What the haze consists of (vapor, dust, or spray) and its cause.
uncertain_details: The camera appears static (background blur unchanged), but minor drift cannot be fully excluded.
The precise motion of the handle and the exact degree of logo occlusion are gradual and hard to quantify frame-to-frame.
Shifts in bright reflections on the plate are due to plate movement, not separate objects.
